title: iLearn-Lab/NeurIPS25-CogVLA
summary: CogVLA is a NeurIPS 2025 vision-language-action model that aligns robot control with cognition by using instruction-driven routing and sparsification, so different parts of the model are selectively activated depending on the task command. The repo appears to package the method for researchers interested in efficient VLA policies that can condition robot behavior on language while avoiding dense, one-size-fits-all computation.

extra.full_text: [NeurIPS 2025] CogVLA: Cognition-Aligned Vision-Language-Action Models via Instruction-Driven Routing & Sparsification
